title: Onboard Cassiopeia-13B v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: Add Cassiopeia-13B v1.0 to the model registry with complete metadata, verified performance profiles across our supported infra, and automated changelog/release-note generation. Scope: model card (architecture/params/tokenizer/hyperparameters), metadata tags for routing and compatibility (quantization, kv-cache support, max_seq_len), performance profiles for A100/H100 in FP16 and int8 quantized configurations, integration with the changelog-action to generate release notes automatically when the model is published. Checklist: 1) Add model metadata JSON and model card summary, 2) Generate and verify perf profiles using perf-lab harness, 3) Add inference test vectors and tokenizer sanity checks, 4) Wire changelog automation metadata for release note generation, 5) Add small docs snippet linking to model page. Verification: unit tests for metadata schema validation were added, perf runs are included as artifacts in the CI job, manual review of model outputs for determinism and tokenization edge cases was performed. Rollout: model is staged in registry as draft then promoted to public after automated changelog is appended. Backwards compatibility: tags include compatible_runtime_versions to allow routing to older runtime variants. See commits and review comments for details.
